admission.justification: The measured short form spans the choke model and the application boundary re-guard, proved by the named passing final-measure cases; it also rides the family guarantee.

applicability: Every over-bound answer for every tool and row, interim rows included.
conditions: The final delivered mapping is measured, including late logging changes.
Once cut, the re-guard uses the short-form target rather than reverting to the original larger bound.
The exact recorded-result location and final cut hint are not removed to meet the target.
exclusions: Under-bound answers do not enter this overflow transformation; their separate default projection/list shaping remains unchanged.
Retaining the recorded path and its final hint can leave the short form above 400 after other droppable content has been removed.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_tool_answer_table.py::ToolAnswerFinalMeasureTests::test_full_short_form_fits_including_bookkeeping + test_cut_answer_late_failure_reguards_at_the_short_ceiling (passing in the R6 run); documentary corpus notes/reports/l108-f14-documentary-successor/worker-documentary-evidence.json (SHA 6601bb084849a73554f0e385cf90028966b8bbe07831333cc81529e7b6e89725); A8 documentary corpus notes/reports/l108-f14-documentary-successor-a8/worker-documentary-evidence.json

statement: An answer over its bound leaves as a measured short form targeting 400 tokens; the guard measures the final delivered mapping including every log and logError change and re-guards a cut answer against the short-form target rather than its original larger bound. The exact recorded-result location and final cut hint remain even when the recorded path and its hint cannot fit that target after other droppable content is removed.
